writing_style: Briefing style, the shortest voice on the network. Two paragraphs, never more. The first paragraph still carries who and what; after it, every sentence introduces a fact the one before it did not, and no sentence merely restates the headline. No scene-setting, no transitions, no "meanwhile". End on a single short status line standing alone, saying where the story now stands — taken from the facts you were given, never a stock phrase.
